access: native verified, strictly mapped active manager/admin tenant membership; global edits additionally require platform administration
evidence: historical source statuses display as pending destination review; evaluated checks need current destination markers; manual passing/not-applicable assertions require a review note and stamped reviewer
automation: fixture shape, identity, lines, numeric totals and declared supported expectations only; mapping/duplicate expectations stay pending; no security, schema or live acceptance is inferred
certification: required destination-reviewed checks, actual destination live-acceptance and security review markers are required; no checks are auto-passed by the evaluator
privacy: raw fixture expected/actual payloads, evidence notes, provider errors and certification metadata are excluded from tenant reader responses
tests: mocked handlers and live rollback tenant/global authorization, historical evidence, positive/negative/unsupported fixtures, manual review, actor, privacy and missing live acceptance checks passed
